LESSON: GEOMETRICAL CONSTRUCTIONS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry
Topic 4.1: Geometrical Constructions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Geometrical Constructions, part of Geometry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we construct polygons? 2. How do we use polygons in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. practice constructing parallel and perpendicular lines individually, in purposive pairs or groups. Those with poor motor coordination or missing limbs could use alternative functional parts of the body, appropriate assistive devices or be assisted by peers or teacher to perform the task. They could also use adapted digital devices with specialized accessibility features and interactive software to perform the activities.

2. practice dividing a line proportionally individually/ in pairs or groups, for example, using a set square and a ruler 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. practice constructing parallel and perpendicular lines individually, in purposive pairs or groups. Those with poor motor coordination or missing limbs could use alternative functional parts of the body, appropriate assistive devices or be assisted by peers or teacher to perform the task. They could also use adapted digital devices with specialized accessibility features and interactive software to perform the activities.
2. practice dividing a line proportionally individually/ in pairs or groups, for example, using a set square and a ruler 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Geometrical Constructions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: as the learner discusses angle properties of polygons and relate the number of right

angles to the number of sides.

• Digital literacy: as the learner uses IT or other devices to create patterns using circles touching sides of triangles or

polygons.

Values

Responsibility: as the learner constructs regular polygons using pair of compasses, rulers and protractors and take care of the
